name: FNCE 5409
title: Advanced Valuation and Portfolio Management
description: Starts with performance measurement, and then discusses various trading and risk management strategies, and concludes with a discussion of the impact of accounting process, and corporate governance on valuation. Technical analysis is briefly discussed at the end. Delivered primarily through discussion of cases.
requirement_description: FNCE 5101 or FNCE 5182; open to MBA students, others with consent.
